candidate: H42 exact-budget role-conditioned 64-branch shallow Givens task-atom atlas
purpose: Test whether the one-percent budget must expose many local manifold directions rather than one deep transported task atom.

frozen_inventory.pca_centering: mean of all 239 states independently for each matrix
frozen_inventory.pc_normalization: unit Frobenius norm independently for every matrix PC
frozen_inventory.pc_weights: eigenvalue normalized within the measured top-16 set; also report total-path-weighted recovery

frozen_decoder.formula: B_nrk=QL_rk D_n QR_rk^T; Yhat_n=sum_k a_nk B_nrk
frozen_decoder.other_branch_anchor: procedural uniform angles on [-pi, pi] from the registered branch seed

fit.objective: mean eigenvalue-weighted ridge projection capture of each training node's top-16 temporal PCs into its 64 generated branch atoms
fit.fit_all: learn one shared 64-branch bank independently for each three-node role
fit.leave_one_out: learn the shared role bank on the other two same-role nodes; fit only legal 64-dimensional projection coordinates for the held-out node
fit.base_control: identical procedural anchors with learned residual angles fixed at zero; local coordinates still optimally projected
fit.forbidden_target_access: no held-out PC enters shared-angle fitting

systems_preflight.preflight_scope: both role fit-all fits plus one held-out fold per role

routing_after_pass: Run the identical bank on chronological-late and disjoint-stream residual PCs before any LM training.
routing_after_failure: Close the exact wide shallow orthogonal atlas and do theory on one causally distinct nonlinear or non-orthogonal task-atom generator.
forbidden_followups: branch, stage, prompt, seed, anchor-range, ridge, iteration, learning-rate, role, or target sweep
claiming a no-go for nonlinear, non-orthogonal, externally amortized, or alternate-solution manifolds
